cd /workspace && timeout 180 python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,time,json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from netnomos.finite import compile_job
D=list(range(256));fields=[{'name':'x','type':'count','domain':D},{'name':'y','type':'count','domain':D}]
preds=[]
for a in range(16): preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'x']},'op':'ne','right':{'const':a,'type':'count'}})
for b in range(16): preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'y']},'op':'ne','right':{'const':b,'type':'count'}})
train=[[[a,255]] for a in range(16)]+[[[255,b]] for b in range(16)]
queries=[{'fixed':[],'target':[0,'x' if i%2 else 'y'],'prefix':''} for i in range(64)]
base={'fields':fields,'slots':1,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':train,'approved':[],'queries':queries}
r=compile_job(base);base['approved']=[x['clause'] for x in r['rules']]
b={'jobs':[base,base]}
st=time.time();out=[compile_job(j) for j in b['jobs']];raw=json.dumps({'results':out},separators=(',',':'));print('total',time.time()-st,'outlen',len(raw),'rules',[len(x['rules']) for x in out])
PY
